title: Spore Altar
description: A flat stone slab rises from the swamp floor, carpeted in living fungus that pulses with a slow, rhythmic glow. Carved channels in the stone guide the mycelium growth into spiraling patterns, and the air above the altar shimmers with drifting spores. This is a place of old ritual -- offerings of bone and coin are half-absorbed into the fungal mat. The altar hums with a low, felt vibration.

choices.label: Make an offering
choices.description: Place gold on the altar and see what the fungus gives in return.

outcomes.text: Your coins sink into the fungal mat and the altar blazes with green light. The mycelium parts, revealing rare materials grown in its depths -- an offering returned tenfold.
The altar accepts your gold and pulses warmly. Healing energy flows up through the stone into your feet and spreads through the party. The fungus seems pleased.
The gold vanishes but the altar darkens. The vibration becomes a grinding moan. Your offering was... insufficient. Spore jets erupt from the channels.

choices.label: Desecrate the altar
choices.description: Scrape the fungus off and take whatever the growth has absorbed.

outcomes.text: You pry the fungal mat loose and find coins, iron fittings, and old offerings absorbed into the growth. A profitable act of vandalism.
The altar screams. A psychic shriek rips through the cavern and the mycelium network convulses. Creatures come boiling out of the walls, drawn by the altar's distress.
The fungal mat releases a concentrated burst of toxic spores as you tear it free. You grab what you can through the burning haze.

choices.label: Kneel and meditate
choices.description: Sit quietly before the altar and let the mycelium's rhythm calm your mind.

outcomes.text: The altar's hum settles into your bones. Tension drains away, wounds feel lighter, and for a moment you understand the vast network beneath your feet.
Visions flash behind your eyes -- paths through the tunnels, hidden caches, safe passages. When you open your eyes, a single glowing spore rests in your palm.
The meditation goes too deep. The mycelium network tries to pull your consciousness in. You wrench free with a splitting headache.
